dedupe_keys.name: gridstatus open source electricity market data library

description: gridstatus is an open-source Python library that fetches electricity market data directly from North American independent system operators and regional transmission organisations and from the US Energy Information Administration, returning it as tables for analysis. It is maintained by Grid Status, a company that also sells a hosted API with a consistent schema across markets, a maintained historical archive and server-side filtering. Coverage is the North American ISO and RTO markets and EIA data, at the time resolution each operator publishes. The library is installed from PyPI (version 0.36.0, Python 3.10 to 3.14) with source on GitHub and documentation at opensource.gridstatus.io, under a BSD-style licence at no cost. Caveats: the open-source library depends on each operator's public interfaces, so availability and history vary by market, and the README steers users who need a consistent schema and archive to the paid hosted API. Simulation uses are load, price and generation time series for capacity planning, optimisation and operational digital twins. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
